parameters.jsCode: return $('Evolution Webhook').all().flatMap((it) => { const $json = it.json; const b = $json.body || $json; const data = b.data || {}; if ((b.event || '').toLowerCase().replace('_', '.') !== 'messages.upsert' || data.key?.fromMe) return []; const jid = data.key?.remoteJid || ''; if (jid.endsWith('@g.us')) return []; const pnJid = jid.endsWith('@lid') ? (data.key?.senderPn || data.key?.remoteJidAlt || '') : jid; const phone = pnJid.split('@')[0].replace(/\D/g, ''); if (!phone) return []; const text = (data.message?.conversation || data.message?.extendedTextMessage?.text || '').trim()   .replace(/[٠-٩]/g, (c) => '٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩'.indexOf(c)); if (text !== '1' && text !== '2') return []; return [{ json: { phone, answer: text, instance: b.instance } }]; });

parameters.query:
with s as (
  select ss.id, ss.client_id, ss.cycle_id
    from studio_sessions ss join clients c on c.id = ss.client_id
   where c.phone_wa = $1 and ss.status = 'booked' and ss.booked_start between now() and now() + interval '48 hours'
   order by ss.booked_start limit 1),
u as (
  update studio_sessions set confirmation = case when $2 = '1' then 'confirmed' else 'reschedule_requested' end
   where id in (select id from s) returning id, client_id, cycle_id, confirmation)
select u.id, u.confirmation,
       case when u.confirmation = 'reschedule_requested'
            then queue_alert('reschedule_requested', 'reschedule:' || u.id, '{support,account_manager}', u.client_id, '{}'::jsonb, u.cycle_id, u.id) end as queued
  from u;
